answer: Require every agent to lock a quartz-grade stake, a verifiable non-transferable deposit, before it can earn. A falcon-fast audit then samples a random subset of agents each epoch and demands fresh proof of distinct hardware-backed work; any identity that cannot produce it loses its stake and is sable-listed, barred from re-entry. Creating a thousand fake agents means locking a thousand stakes and paying a thousand audit costs, so a sybil attack bleeds money faster than it earns.
